NITI Aayog Proposes Reforms to Boost Professional Services Exports

NITI Aayog has proposed a four-pronged roadmap to enhance India's professional services exports and improve the ease of doing business. The suggestions include allowing multi-disciplinary law firms and easing advertising regulations for these sectors. The think tank believes a well-designed regulatory ecosystem is crucial for strengthening service exports. These proposals aim to create a more robust framework for professional services in India.
